**妖獸 1.** 哪種同步工具提供了 wait() 和 signal() 操作？

- A. Mutex locks
- B. Monitors
- C. Condition variables
- D. Semaphores

- A. Producer
- B. Consumer

- D. Both use it

- A. read_count
